items.title: Legend's first try in 1,426 days inspires Cowboys turnaround
items.summary: Jason Taumalolo has ended a four year try-scoring drought to inspire North Queensland to victory over Gold Coast.

items.summary: A young father who suffered permanent brain damage after a Victoria Police officer fell on him during a bungled arrest in 2022 has quietly settled a lawsuit with the force in a deal believed to be worth almost $14 million.

items.summary: In her first public appearance since fleeing to India two years ago, Bangladesh's "Iron Lady" didn't use the moment to confront the crimes for which she has been sentenced to death. Instead, she used it to signal her ongoing power as a political contender.

items.title: Anti-abortion campaigner Joanna Howe clashes with Vickie Chapman at Women's Council meeting
items.summary: A Liberal Women's Council meeting has become a flash point for the ideological rift plaguing the South Australian party as a prominent anti-abortion campaigner clashed with the former deputy premier.

items.title: Queanbeyan's Miles Franklin Literary Award winner praises his mum, describes 'slog' of 21 drafts

items.title: Complaints of confusion and not enough communication ahead of Census night

items.title: NT police commissioner fires back at Labor MP Luke Gosling over arrest 'politicisation' claim
items.summary: Martin Dole says a claim from Luke Gosling's lawyer that the MP's arrest was politicised is "offensive" and part of a "strategy".

items.title: Court fines Bucca blueberry farmers $100,000 for building an illegal dam
items.summary: The NSW Land and Environment Court fines two Mid North Coast blueberry farmers $100,000 for building an illegal dam, but they will not have to demolish it.

items.title: Kumanjayi Little Baby's family sets date for funeral to honour five-year-old girl's memory
items.summary: Months on from the desperate search for five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby by hundreds of volunteers, her grandfather is inviting the community to come together once more for her funeral in Alice Springs later this month.

items.title: Man convicted of killing teenager Cassius Turvey fails to reduce jail sentence

items.title: Investigations underway into surgery mix-up at hospital in Melbourne's west

items.title: Book showcases Australia's retro television from Skippy to Hey Hey It's Saturday

items.title: Disgraced AFL great Nicky Winmar should be jailed over assault, prosecutors say
